title: Perimeter vs Area: What's the Difference?
description: A side-by-side visual comparing perimeter (the distance around a shape) with area (the space inside it).
narration_lines: Perimeter and area sound similar, but they're not the same thing.
Here's the same 6 by 4 rectangle as before.
This time, trace only the outline — the distance all the way around.
That's 20 units around. Perimeter is the edge; area is the space inside.

params.footnote: perimeter is the distance around; area is the space inside
